latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of local-memory-for-openclaw

- Adds local AI memory management with all data stored on device for privacy.
- Automatically extracts and manages key facts, preferences, progress, and to-dos from conversations.
- Injects relevant memories into each conversation for better context retention.
- Supports manual memory commands: save, recall, delete, and list.
- Handles automatic memory updates, conflict resolution, and expiration.
- Easy configuration via config.json; no external services or fees required.
